title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的主线是「基础设施的下半场」与「记忆的竞争」。Anthropic 把 Claude 的记忆统一到了 Chat 和 Cowork 之间，Garry Tan 一句「cross-harness memory maxxing」点破了竞争的本质——记忆要跨工具、跨 harness 才算数。OpenAI 这边同时放出两枚信号：Sam Altman 轻描淡写一句「我们做了颗芯片」，Sottiaux 预告面向团队、没有 5 小时限额的新方案，而 Swyx 的 PSA 提醒你 Codex 的「locked use」还踩在 macOS 的不稳定特性上。底层手艺也没停：Madhu Guru 讲到评测要跟着用量一起演化，Rauch 把 agent 基建从笨重沙箱推进到安全原语，Levie 则把「应用层 AI」的机会讲透了。而今天的播客是一记重锤：前 Twitter CEO Parag Agrawal 赌下一个网络会为 agent 从头重建——他说，人类的点击数据是个 bug。

archive.title: 记忆与 agent 基建日报
archive.desc: Claude 统一记忆，Garry Tan 点破「跨 harness 记忆」的竞争本质；OpenAI 自研芯片与面向团队的新方案现身；前 Twitter CEO 赌下一个网络为 agent 重建，agent 基建从沙箱走向安全原语。

sections.title: Unified Memory / 记忆统一
sections.desc: Anthropic 把 Claude 的记忆统一到 Chat 与 Cowork 之间，而真正的战场在「跨 harness」——记忆必须跟着 builder 走遍每一个工具。

rewrite: Anthropic ships a real UX change for Claude: one memory that follows you across Chat and Claude Cowork, and you control what goes into it. Hand Cowork a task and it starts from what Claude already knows from your chats — the project you talked through, your manager's preferences, or the client from last quarter.

Memory is on by default for Free, Pro and Max plans, and what gets stored is transparent: everything is saved as a list of topics in Settings, where you can read, edit or delete each item, and it updates on its own as you chat. You can also say "remember this" to pin something specific.
Sensitive topics are excluded by default: subjects like health or religious beliefs stay out of memory unless you explicitly turn them on in Settings.
original: Claude now has one memory across chat and Claude Cowork, and you decide what's in it.
Hand Cowork a task and it starts from what Claude already knows from your chats: the project you talked through, your manager's preferences, or the client from last quarter.
Memory is on by default on Free, Pro, and Max plans. Review yours anytime in Settings > Memory.
Topics some consider sensitive, like health or religious beliefs, stay out of memory unless you turn them on in Settings.
Everything Claude remembers is saved as a list of topics in Settings, where you can read, edit, or delete each one.

rewrite: Anthropic 给 Claude 上了一个真正的产品改动：一套跨 Chat 和 Claude Cowork 的统一记忆，而且由你决定里面放什么。把任务交给 Cowork 时，它会从 Claude 在你聊天里已经知道的信息出发——你们讨论过的项目、你老板的偏好，或者上个季度的那个客户。
记忆在 Free、Pro 和 Max 计划上默认开启，而且存储内容是透明的：所有记忆都以主题列表的形式存在 Settings 里，你可以逐条阅读、编辑或删除；它还会在你聊天时自动更新。你也可以说一句「remember this」来固定某个具体信息。
敏感话题默认被排除在外：像健康或宗教信仰这类内容，除非你在 Settings 里主动打开，否则不会进入记忆。

rewrite: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan's one-line reaction to the memory news doubles as a founder thesis: the edge is not memory inside one product, but memory that travels across every tool a builder uses. His phrase — "cross-harness memory maxxing" — names the strategy of keeping context shared across Claude Code, Codex and every other AI harness you touch.
original: You need to be cross-harness memory maxxing

rewrite: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan 对这次记忆发布的一句评论，本身就是一句创业者方法论：真正的护城河不是某个产品内部的记忆，而是能穿越你使用的每一个工具的记忆。他造的词「cross-harness memory maxxing」（跨 harness 记忆拉满），点明了把上下文在 Claude Code、Codex 以及你碰过的每个 AI harness 之间共享的策略。
original: 你需要做 cross-harness memory maxxing。

sections.title: OpenAI: Chip & Team Plan / OpenAI 的芯片与新方案
sections.desc: Sam Altman 一句四字预告自研芯片，Sottiaux 预告面向团队、无 5 小时限额的新方案，而 Swyx 提醒你桌面端 Codex 的地基还没稳。

rewrite: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux (Codex & ChatGPT) previews a new Business plan aimed at teams and small companies. It works like the Pro $100 plan but adds everything a company needs: all ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex features, connectors into Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub and Microsoft 365, SAML/SSO/MFA, centralized billing and administration, usage analytics with spend controls, and no 5-hour limits.

His separate one-liner — "Good products take time. At least 34 days." — reads as a nod to the gap between announcement and shipping, a reminder that OpenAI's consumer roadmap is being paced deliberately.
original: So much demand for this one. Works similar to the Pro $100 plan but designed for teams and small companies.

✅ All ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex features ✅ Connect to Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Microsoft 365, and more ✅ Secure workspace with SAML, SSO, and MFA ✅ Centralized billing and administration ✅ Usage analytics and spend controls ✅ No 5h limits
Good products take time. At least 34 days.

他另一句单独的话——「好产品需要时间。至少 34 天。」——像是在回应从预告到上线的间隔，提醒大家 OpenAI 的消费级路线图在刻意控制节奏。

There is no spec sheet, no benchmark, no roadmap. Just a signal that OpenAI is now building its own silicon, which would rewrite the cost and compute equation that the entire agent economy runs on.

rewrite: Swyx (smol.ai founder, Latent Space) posts a public service announcement for anyone using Codex's "locked use" capabilities: avoid them for now. The feature currently relies on unstable macOS features and has locked him out of his macOS keychain twice in a single week, with Apple's developer forums acknowledging it as a "known bug".

The point is not to dunk on Codex — he notes it would be nice to do everything in the cloud, but cloud isn't there yet. It is a practical reminder that bleeding-edge agent features on the desktop still sit on shaky OS foundations.

sections.title: Rebuilding the Web for Agents / 为 agent 重建网络
sections.desc: 前 Twitter CEO Parag Agrawal 的 Parallel 把搜索重新定义为「给 agent 用的东西」：人类点击数据是 bug，排序模型才是答案。

rewrite: The takeaway: web search was built for lazy humans, and Parag Agrawal is betting the next web gets rebuilt from scratch for AI agents. Agrawal — the former Twitter CEO who sold the company to Elon Musk — now runs Parallel, a company building "agentic search" on one core conviction: "human click data is a bug," and agent search should learn from agent feedback instead.

His thesis is blunt. Agents will search the web a thousand times more than humans ever did, so the technology and the business model both need reinvention. Rather than raise billions to crawl the whole web up front, Parallel started with a "search agent" — a product that crawls after a query arrives — then built its index incrementally from real customer use cases like insurance underwriting and sales data enrichment.

He frames search as a billion-to-billion matching problem: every query is essentially "give me a thousand tokens from a trillion web pages, and make sure they're the right thousand tokens." Parallel's answer is to compress information into tiny ranking models that pick those tokens within tight latency budgets, now down to 200 milliseconds.

The practical payoff: he claims agents using Parallel search use under half the tokens, become more accurate, and finish faster. He also resists the "NeoLab" label — his output is not a model but a complement to one: whenever someone ships a better model, that unlocks more use cases for Parallel, not more competition.
original: Our view at Parallel is that human click data is a bug, and agent doing work with search should rely on agent feedback, not human feedback.
We started Parallel with the bet that agents would do it a thousand x more than humans ever have.
You have hundreds of billions of pages and hundreds of billions of queries over time, and you need to figure out how to matchmake across these two.
Every query is essentially, give me a thousand tokens from a trillion web pages on the web and make sure they're the right thousand tokens.
If you use parallel search, you will, for the most part, use under half the tokens in your agent. It will become more accurate and faster.
Somebody ships a better model, they have now unlocked four more use cases where we can be valuable.

rewrite: 一句话 Takeaway：网络搜索是为「懒人」设计的，而 Parag Agrawal 赌的是——下一个网络会为 AI agent 从头重建。Agrawal 是把 Twitter 卖给 Elon Musk 的前 CEO，如今经营 Parallel，一家基于一个核心信念做「agentic search」的公司：人类点击数据是 bug，agent 搜索应该从 agent 反馈里学习，而不是人类反馈。
他的论点很直白：agent 上网搜索的次数将是人类的一千倍，所以技术和商业模式都需要重新发明。Parallel 没有一上来就砸几十亿去爬全网，而是先做了一款「search agent」——查询到达后才去爬取——然后从保险核保、销售数据补全这类真实客户场景里逐步建起自己的索引。
他把搜索描述成一个「十亿对十亿」的匹配问题：每一次查询本质上就是「从万亿网页里给我一千个 token，而且要保证是对的那一千个」。Parallel 的答案是，把信息压缩进极小的排序模型，在极紧的延迟预算里挑出这些 token，现在已经做到 200 毫秒。
实际的收益：他声称用 Parallel 搜索的 agent，token 用量能降到一半以下，更准也更快。他还拒绝「NeoLab」这个标签——他的产出不是模型，而是模型的补充：每当有人发布更好的模型，对 Parallel 来说不是竞争加剧，而是解锁了更多它能发挥价值的场景。
original: 我们在 Parallel 的看法是，人类点击数据是 bug，用搜索干活的 agent 应该依赖 agent 反馈，而不是人类反馈。
我们创立 Parallel 时的赌注是：agent 使用搜索的次数会是人类的一千倍。
你有上千亿页面、上千亿次查询，你得想办法在两者之间做匹配。
每一次查询本质上就是：从网上的万亿网页里给我一千个 token，并保证它们是对的那一千个。
如果你用 Parallel 搜索，多数情况下你的 agent 只用到一半以下的 token，而且更准、更快。
有人发布更好的模型，反而为我们解锁了四个更多能发挥价值的场景。

sections.title: Evals & Agent Infrastructure / 评测与 agent 基建
sections.desc: Madhu Guru 说评测要跟着用量一起演化；Vercel 把 agent 基建从笨重沙箱推进到安全、专用的原语。

rewrite: Madhu Guru, Sr. Director of AI at Meta (previously Google, where he led Gemini, Veo and Nano Banana), continues his eval series with Part 9: the Eval Roadmap Problem. His argument: most evals fail because teams treat them as static artifacts while user expectations and behavior keep evolving.

He walks through a financial research agent: early users ask to summarize a 5-page earnings report; three weeks later they want the growth story across five reports; two months later they want an investment thesis from 15 filings and transcripts; eventually they want a portfolio monitor that alerts them when something materially changes the thesis.

The prescription: map the dimensions along which usage will evolve (turns, document size, tool use, autonomy), mine production traces for shifts, and build P0 evals for the next stage before you need them. "If your evals are stuck in week 1 while users are in week 3, it will show in your product and churn metrics."
original: Most evals fail because teams treat them as static artifacts while their users expectations and behaviors have evolved.

Early user: Summarize this 5-page earnings report. 3 weeks later: review the last 5 earnings reports and explain their growth story. 2 months later: Here are 15 filings, earnings transcripts and research reports. Build an investment thesis. Eventually: Monitor my stock portfolio and tell send me alerts when something materially changes my thesis.

Your evals should change with usage patterns: short-context -> long-context, single-turn QA -> multi-turn, passage citations -> doc and line citations, Simple QA -> complex synthesis, reactive chat -> proactive agent.
If your evals are stuck in week 1 while users are in week 3, it will show in your product and churn metrics.

rewrite: Madhu Guru，Meta 的 AI 高级总监（此前在 Google 主导 Gemini、Veo 和 Nano Banana），继续他的评测系列，写到第九篇：评测路线图问题。核心论点：大多数评测之所以失败，是因为团队把它们当成静态工件，而用户的预期和行为一直在演化。
他用一个金融研究 agent 举例：早期用户要求「总结这份 5 页财报」；三周后变成「回顾最近 5 份财报，讲清增长故事」；两个月后变成「这里有 15 份文件、财报电话会和研报，构建投资论点」；最终变成「监控我的股票组合，当某件事实质性改变我的论点时提醒我」。
他给的药方：先画出用量会沿哪些维度演化（轮数、文档规模、工具使用、自主性），从生产 trace 里挖掘变化，然后提前为下一阶段构建 P0 评测。「如果你的评测还停在第 1 周、而用户已经走到第 3 周，这会在你的产品和流失率上显现出来。」
original: 大多数评测失败，是因为团队把它们当成静态工件，而用户的预期和行为已经演化。
早期用户：总结这份 5 页财报。三周后：回顾最近 5 份财报并讲清增长故事。两个月后：这里有 15 份文件、财报电话会和研报，构建一个投资论点。最终：监控我的股票组合，当某件事实质性改变我的论点时提醒我。
你的评测应该随用量模式改变：短上下文 → 长上下文，单轮 QA → 多轮，段落引用 → 文档与行级引用，简单 QA → 复杂综合，被动聊天 → 主动 agent。
如果你的评测还停在第 1 周、而用户已经在第 3 周，这会在你的产品和流失率上显现出来。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch names what he calls the hardest problem in building agents: secure connectivity to services and data. Vercel Connect is now GA — one command ("vercel connect create notion") gives you an MCP client you can query on behalf of an authenticated user, without hand-rolling OAuth for every integration.

Alongside it he ships Run SDK, a lighter-weight alternative to full sandboxes: when agents write code, you can run it in a secure QuickJS context instead of spinning up a whole sandbox — faster and more cost-efficient. The through-line: agent infrastructure is moving from heavy, general-purpose sandboxes toward secure, purpose-built primitives.
original: The hardest problem in building agents is secure connectivity to services and data.
Excited for Vercel Connect to be GA. Run e.g: vercel connect create notion, then get an MCP client you can query on behalf of the authenticated user.

We're introducing Run SDK: secure eval for dynamic Code Mode execution. When agents write code, you don't always need a full sandbox. You can run their code in a lightweight QuickJS secure context. Faster and more cost-efficient.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 点名了他认为构建 agent 最难的难题：安全地连接到服务和数据。Vercel Connect 现已 GA——一条命令（vercel connect create notion）就能拿到一个 MCP client，可以代表已认证用户去查询，而不必为每一个集成手搓 OAuth。
同时他还发布了 Run SDK，作为完整沙箱之外更轻量的替代：当 agent 写代码时，你不必每次都起一整个沙箱，可以在轻量的 QuickJS 安全上下文里直接运行，更快也更省钱。贯穿其中的主线是：agent 基础设施正在从笨重的通用沙箱，转向安全、专用的原语。
original: 构建 agent 最难的难题，是安全地连接到服务和数据。
很高兴 Vercel Connect 正式 GA。比如运行 vercel connect create notion，就能拿到一个可以代表已认证用户查询的 MCP client。
我们推出 Run SDK：用于动态 Code Mode 执行的安全 eval。当 agent 写代码时，你不一定需要完整的沙箱，可以在轻量的 QuickJS 安全上下文里运行，更快、更省钱。

sections.title: Applied AI / 落地与应用
sections.desc: Levie 把「应用层 AI」的机会讲透，Peter Yang 则把一个真实的开源 skill 放到了台上。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie highlights a post on what applied AI strategy looks like at scale. His read: there is a wide gap between AI models and the actual workflows of an enterprise, and that gap is where the biggest opportunity sits for applied AI companies.

The quote he amplifies frames it sharply: the world doesn't just want raw models and agents — it wants problems resolved and outcomes achieved. The premium will go to companies that can diffuse intelligence through every aspect of a business, converting raw tokens into real-world outcomes.

Doing that well, he argues, means owning context, driving change management, routing across models, connecting to the critical systems in a vertical, and solving the UX of connecting users to agents — a ton of value that sits beyond the model itself.
original: It's clear that there's a wide gap between the AI models and the underlying workflows of an enterprise, which leaves a ton of opportunity for applied AI companies.

The world doesn't just want raw models and agents; it wants problems resolved and outcomes achieved. The premium will sit with the companies that can diffuse this intelligence through every aspect of civilization, converting raw tokens into real world outcomes.

That's a ton of value that goes beyond just the model intelligence itself. And there's a window of opportunity right now to build the defining companies that can bring intelligence to the critical domains in an enterprise.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 转发并点评了一篇关于「规模化应用 AI 战略」的文章。他的判断：AI 模型与企业真实工作流之间存在巨大鸿沟，而这道鸿沟正是应用层 AI 公司最大的机会。
他引用的那段话把这件事说得非常锋利：世界要的不只是裸模型和 agent，而是问题被解决、结果被达成。溢价会流向那些能把智能扩散进业务每个角落、把裸 token 转化为真实世界成果的公司。
要做好这件事，他认为意味着：理解业务上下文、推动变革管理、在多个模型之间路由、接入垂直领域的关键系统、解决「如何把用户和 agent 正确连接」的 UX 难题——这些价值远在模型智能本身之外。
original: AI 模型与企业真实工作流之间存在巨大鸿沟，这给应用层 AI 公司留下了大量机会。
世界要的不只是裸模型和 agent；它要的是问题被解决、结果被达成。溢价会流向那些能把智能扩散进文明每一个角落、把裸 token 转化为真实世界成果的公司。
这是远超模型智能本身的价值。而且现在正有一个窗口期，去打造那些能把智能带入企业关键领域的定义性公司。

rewrite: Peter Yang open-sources /fuck-cancer, an AI skill that helps patients and caregivers navigate a cancer diagnosis and advocate for themselves. Built from his own family's experience, it creates and updates a single source-of-truth brief with five sections: patient and care-team info, three next actions, confirmed facts vs. unknowns, medical terms in plain English, and a care log.

It builds the brief from documents and context you provide, pulls from trusted sources like the National Cancer Institute and ClinicalTrials.gov when research is needed, and works with ChatGPT/Codex and Claude Code. It can save the brief as a local Markdown file or update a shareable Google Doc so the whole family works from the same information.
original: Today, I'm open-sourcing /fuck-cancer, an AI skill that helps patients and caregivers navigate cancer diagnosis and treatment and advocate for themselves and their loved ones.
The volume of doctors, documents, and insurance paperwork can quickly become overwhelming.

It creates and updates a practical brief with five sections: patient and care-team information, what to do next limited to three specific actions, what we know, medical terms explained in plain English, and a care log with recent updates and decisions.
